questions.question: The following function has a local minima at which value of [latex]x[/latex]? [latex]f(x)=x\sqrt{5-x^{2}}[/latex]
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{aligned} f\left ( x \right )&=x\sqrt{5-x^{2}} \\ {f}'\left ( x \right )&=\sqrt{5-x^{2}}+\frac{x\times -2x}{2\sqrt{5-x^{2}}} \\ 5-x^{2}&=x^{2} \\ 2x^{2}&=5 \\ x&=\pm \sqrt{\frac{5}{2}}\end{aligned}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html: [latex]\begin{aligned} f\left ( x \right )&=x\sqrt{5-x^{2}} \\ {f}'\left ( x \right )&=\sqrt{5-x^{2}}+\frac{x\times -2x}{2\sqrt{5-x^{2}}} \\ 5-x^{2}&=x^{2} \\ 2x^{2}&=5 \\ x&=\pm \sqrt{\frac{5}{2}}\end{aligned}[/latex]

questions.question: The value of the following improper integral is [latex]\int_{0}^{1}xlnx[/latex]
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{aligned} \int_{0}^{1}x\log xdx&=\log x\int_{0}^{1}xdx-\int_{0}^{1}\left ( \frac{1}{x}\int xdx \right )dx \\   &=\frac{x^{2}}{2}\log x-\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{x}\frac{x^{2}}{2}dx \\   &=\left [ \frac{x^{2}}{2}\log x-\frac{x^{2}}{4} \right ]^{1}_{0} \\   &=\left ( 0-\frac{1}{4} \right )-\left ( 0-0 \right )=-\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html: [latex]\begin{aligned} \int_{0}^{1}x\log xdx&=\log x\int_{0}^{1}xdx-\int_{0}^{1}\left ( \frac{1}{x}\int xdx \right )dx \\   &=\frac{x^{2}}{2}\log x-\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{x}\frac{x^{2}}{2}dx \\   &=\left [ \frac{x^{2}}{2}\log x-\frac{x^{2}}{4} \right ]^{1}_{0} \\   &=\left ( 0-\frac{1}{4} \right )-\left ( 0-0 \right )=-\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}[/latex]

questions.question: The force 'F' required at equilibrium on the semi-cylindrical gate shown below is
questions.explanation: Depth of water (H)=2 m Consider unit width, of cylinder, [latex] \begin{aligned} F_{H} &=\rho g \bar{h} A_{h} \\ &=1000 \times 9.81 \times\left(\frac{2}{2}\right) \times(2 \times 1) \\ &=19.62 \mathrm{kN} / \mathrm{m} \text { width } \end{aligned}[/latex] Vertical component, [latex] \begin{aligned} F_{v}&=\rho g(\text { volume })\\ &=1000 \times 9.81\left(\frac{\pi R^{2}}{2} \times 1\right) \\ &=15.41 \mathrm{kN} / \mathrm{m} \text { width } \end{aligned}[/latex] location of center of pressure of [latex]F_{h} [/latex] [latex] h^{*}=\frac{2}{3} H=\frac{4}{3} m [/latex] location of center of pressure of [latex]F_{v} [/latex] [latex] \therefore \quad \bar{x}=\frac{4 R}{3 \pi}=\frac{4 \times 1}{3 \pi}=0.424 \mathrm{m} [/latex] Moment about hinge, [latex] \begin{aligned} \therefore \quad F_{H} \times\left(h^{*}-\bar{h}\right)&=F_{V} \times \bar{x}+F \times 1 \\ \therefore 19.62 \times\left(\frac{4}{3}-1\right)&=15.41 \times 0.424+F \times 1 \\ \therefore \quad F&=0 \mathrm{kN} \end{aligned}[/latex]

Depth of water (H)=2 m
Consider unit width, of cylinder,
[latex] \begin{aligned} F_{H} &=\rho g \bar{h} A_{h} \\ &=1000 \times 9.81 \times\left(\frac{2}{2}\right) \times(2 \times 1) \\ &=19.62 \mathrm{kN} / \mathrm{m} \text { width } \end{aligned}[/latex]
Vertical component,
[latex] \begin{aligned} F_{v}&=\rho g(\text { volume })\\ &=1000 \times 9.81\left(\frac{\pi R^{2}}{2} \times 1\right) \\ &=15.41 \mathrm{kN} / \mathrm{m} \text { width } \end{aligned}[/latex]
location of center of pressure of [latex]F_{h} [/latex]
[latex] h^{*}=\frac{2}{3} H=\frac{4}{3} m [/latex]
location of center of pressure of [latex]F_{v} [/latex]
[latex] \therefore \quad \bar{x}=\frac{4 R}{3 \pi}=\frac{4 \times 1}{3 \pi}=0.424 \mathrm{m} [/latex]
Moment about hinge,
[latex] \begin{aligned} \therefore \quad F_{H} \times\left(h^{*}-\bar{h}\right)&=F_{V} \times \bar{x}+F \times 1 \\ \therefore 19.62 \times\left(\frac{4}{3}-1\right)&=15.41 \times 0.424+F \times 1 \\ \therefore \quad F&=0 \mathrm{kN} \end{aligned}[/latex]

questions.question:
The time for a clay layer to achieve 85% consolidation is 10 years. If the layer was
half as thick, 10 times more permeable and 4 times more compressible then the
time that would be required to achieve the same degree of consolidation is
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{aligned} k &=C_{v} m_{v} \gamma_{w} \\ T_{v} &=\frac{C_{v} t}{h^{2}} \\ \therefore \quad \text { and } \quad t_{1} &=\frac{h_{1}^{2} T_{v}}{k_{1}} m_{v} \gamma_{w} \\ \therefore \quad & t_{2}=\frac{h_{2}^{2} T_{v}}{k_{2}} m_{v} \gamma_{w} \\ & \frac{t_{1}}{t_{2}}=\left(\frac{h_{1}}{h_{2}}\right)^{2} \times \frac{T_{v}}{T_{v}} \times \frac{k_{2}}{k_{1}} \times \frac{m_{v 1}}{m_{v 2}}\\ \frac{t_{2}}{t_{1}} &=\left(\frac{h_{2}}{h_{1}}\right)^{2} \times \frac{k_{1}}{k_{2}} \times \frac{m_{v 2}}{m_{v 1}} \\ &=\frac{1}{4} \times 1 \times \frac{1}{10} \times 4=\frac{1}{10} \\ t_{2} &=\frac{t_{1}}{10}=\frac{10}{10}=1 \text { year } \end{aligned}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html: [latex]\begin{aligned} k &=C_{v} m_{v} \gamma_{w} \\ T_{v} &=\frac{C_{v} t}{h^{2}} \\ \therefore \quad \text { and } \quad t_{1} &=\frac{h_{1}^{2} T_{v}}{k_{1}} m_{v} \gamma_{w} \\ \therefore \quad & t_{2}=\frac{h_{2}^{2} T_{v}}{k_{2}} m_{v} \gamma_{w} \\ & \frac{t_{1}}{t_{2}}=\left(\frac{h_{1}}{h_{2}}\right)^{2} \times \frac{T_{v}}{T_{v}} \times \frac{k_{2}}{k_{1}} \times \frac{m_{v 1}}{m_{v 2}}\\ \frac{t_{2}}{t_{1}} &=\left(\frac{h_{2}}{h_{1}}\right)^{2} \times \frac{k_{1}}{k_{2}} \times \frac{m_{v 2}}{m_{v 1}} \\ &=\frac{1}{4} \times 1 \times \frac{1}{10} \times 4=\frac{1}{10} \\ t_{2} &=\frac{t_{1}}{10}=\frac{10}{10}=1 \text { year } \end{aligned}[/latex]

questions.question:
In a triaxial test carried out on a cohesionless soil sample with a cell pressure of
20 kPa, the observed value of applied stress at the point of failure was 40 kPa.
The angle of internal friction of the soil is
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{aligned} \text{Given,}\quad \sigma_{1} &=\sigma_{a}+\sigma_{3} \\ &=40+20=60 \mathrm{kPa} \\ \text{Now,}\quad \sigma_{1} &=\sigma_{3} N_{0}+2 \mathrm{c} \sqrt{\mathrm{N}_{2}}\\ \text{Where }\quad c&=0\\ \frac{\sigma_{1}}{\sigma_{3}} &=N_{0}=\frac{60}{20}=3 \\ &=\tan ^{2}\left(45^{\circ}+\frac{\phi}{2}\right)\\ \tan \left(45^{\circ}+\frac{\phi}{2}\right)&=\sqrt{3}=1.732 \\ 45^{\circ}+\frac{\phi}{2}&=60^{\circ} \\ \text{or }\quad \frac{\phi}{2}&=60^{\circ}-45^{\circ} \\ \phi&=30^{\circ} \end{aligned}\\[/latex]
questions.explanation_html: [latex]\begin{aligned} \text{Given,}\quad \sigma_{1} &=\sigma_{a}+\sigma_{3} \\ &=40+20=60 \mathrm{kPa} \\ \text{Now,}\quad \sigma_{1} &=\sigma_{3} N_{0}+2 \mathrm{c} \sqrt{\mathrm{N}_{2}}\\ \text{Where }\quad c&=0\\ \frac{\sigma_{1}}{\sigma_{3}} &=N_{0}=\frac{60}{20}=3 \\ &=\tan ^{2}\left(45^{\circ}+\frac{\phi}{2}\right)\\ \tan \left(45^{\circ}+\frac{\phi}{2}\right)&=\sqrt{3}=1.732 \\ 45^{\circ}+\frac{\phi}{2}&=60^{\circ} \\ \text{or }\quad \frac{\phi}{2}&=60^{\circ}-45^{\circ} \\ \phi&=30^{\circ} \end{aligned}\\[/latex]
